d: Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne rajy ke bijli upbhoktaon ke lie ek behad mahatvapurn aur bari ghoshna ki hai. mukhyamantri ne bataya ki 1 disanbar se pure bihar men ek vishesh abhiyan chalaya jaega, jiske tahat 125 yunit mupht bijli ka labh le rahe upbhokta apni ichchha se is suvidha ko chhor (sarendar kar) sakenge.
